title: PAH-OMC-020 exact OMC-004 root-footprint overlap bound
question: Does the unchanged OMC-004 PH/LK/AP dependency footprint supply one n-uniform overlap branching constant that can instantiate the R-515 connected-word envelope without changing the PAH model?
finding: Yes for the declared proof footprint: OMC-004 gives at most four edge slots per column, sixteen PH/AP/LK roots per column and radius at most two, so the conservative overlap branching bound is b=144 and a two-column support has first-root bound a=112. Exact reconstruction at n=2,3,4,6,10,20 gives maxima 56 and 70, below 144. Primary, non-importing independent, hostile and Lean lanes pass. The connected-word-to-Duhamel/coupling attribution remains unproved, so N2c/N4 and anchored-n convergence remain open.
decision_reason: This closes a previously missing source-derived combinatorial input for R-515 rather than repeating a finite carrier calculation. The bound follows from the exact OMC-004 degree/incidence rules, and adversarial controls reject diagonal omission, an under-radius mutation and an invalid factorial ratio. No generator, rate, state, carrier, regulator, time or limit order is modified.
boundary: Exact PAH-001 PH/LK/AP dependency footprints on OMC-004 G_n after the registered R-511 j-limit; the bound is a locality input only. No connected-word-to-Duhamel theorem, common-space map, anchored-n limit or physical interpretation is included.
next_action: Find or refute one source-authorized coupling/Duhamel construction that bounds the exact A_n^(out,m)Q_n(s)g term by connected root words counted with b=144; do not add rates, carriers, projections or physical time.
method: Hash-pin PAH-001, OMC-001, OMC-004, OMC-018, OMC-020 and the R-515 path-word certificate.
Reconstruct the exact two-row strip, PH/LK/AP dependency sets, root counts, column radius and overlap graph.
Derive b=144 and a=112 from the source degree/incidence inequalities, then compare with exact enumerations at six n values.
Replay independent non-importing arithmetic and hostile mutation controls, and compile the finite Lean declarations.
Keep the word-to-Duhamel/coupling attribution as a named missing input rather than promoting the combinatorial bound to N2c/N4.
verification_summary: Primary 45/45, non-importing independent 18/18, hostile 13/13 and integrated 13/13 pass; Lean 4.32.1 compiles two finite declarations. All lanes remain auxiliary and claim-nonbearing.
assumptions: The OMC-004 degree and face-incidence bounds apply uniformly to the declared strip family for every n>=2.
The R-511 j-limit scope leaves the PH/LK/AP source labels and partial-root domains unchanged.
A future source-authorized locality construction may use the dependency footprint to count connected words; that construction is not assumed here.
